rules.sentence: When reading `MASTER-IN` finds no more records, it reads `MASTER-IN` and sets `WS-MASTER-KEY` to `ALL '9'`.
When reading `MASTER-IN` finds a record, it reads `MASTER-IN`, sets `DISPUTE-CASE` to `MASTER-IN-RECORD`, and sets `WS-MASTER-KEY` to `DC-CASE-NO`.
When reading `EVENTS-IN` finds no more records, it reads `EVENTS-IN` and sets `WS-EVENT-KEY` to `ALL '9'`.
When reading `EVENTS-IN` finds a record, it reads `EVENTS-IN` and sets `WS-EVENT-KEY` to `DE-CASE-NO`.
When `WS-MASTER-KEY` is less than `WS-EVENT-KEY`, it sets `DISPUTE-CASE` to `MASTER-IN-RECORD`, writes `DISPUTE-CASE`, and performs `READ-MASTER`.

When `WS-MASTER-KEY` is at least `WS-EVENT-KEY` and `WS-MASTER-KEY` is `WS-EVENT-KEY`, it sets `WS-HELD-CASE` to `MASTER-IN-RECORD`, sets `WS-HOLDING` to `HOLDING-CASE`, performs `READ-MASTER`, and performs `APPLY-EVENTS`.
When `WS-MASTER-KEY` is at least `WS-EVENT-KEY` and `WS-MASTER-KEY` is not `WS-EVENT-KEY`, it sets `WS-HOLDING` to `HOLDING-NOTHING` and performs `APPLY-EVENTS`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`), it sets `DC-CASE-NO` to `WS-EVENT-KEY`, repeats its loop until `WS-EVENT-KEY` is not `DC-CASE-NO`, sets `DISPUTE-CASE` to `WS-HELD-CASE`, and writes `DISPUTE-CASE`.
When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`), it sets `DC-CASE-NO` to `WS-EVENT-KEY` and repeats its loop until `WS-EVENT-KEY` is not `DC-CASE-NO`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`), tested again, it sets `DISPUTE-CASE` to `WS-HELD-CASE`, performs `APPLY-EVENT`, sets `WS-HELD-CASE` to `DISPUTE-CASE`, and performs `READ-EVENT`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`), tested again, it performs `APPLY-EVENT`, sets `WS-HELD-CASE` to `DISPUTE-CASE`, and performs `READ-EVENT`.
When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`); and `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`), tested again, it performs `APPLY-EVENT` and performs `READ-EVENT`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is `'N'` (`HOLDING-NOTHING`) and `DE-EVENT` is `'OP'` (`DE-OPENED`), it sets `DC-CASE-NO` to `DE-CASE-NO`, sets `DC-MERCHANT` to `DE-MERCHANT`, sets `DC-AMOUNT` to `DE-AMOUNT`, sets `DC-OPENED` to `DE-DATE`, sets `DC-STATUS` to `DC-OPEN`, sets `WS-HOLDING` to `HOLDING-CASE`, and sets `DC-UPDATED` to `DE-DATE`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'N'` (not `HOLDING-NOTHING`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'OP'` (not `DE-OPENED`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`) and `DC-STATUS` is `'OP'` (`DC-OPEN`) and `DE-EVENT` is `'CB'` (`DE-CHARGEBACK`), it sets `DC-STATUS` to `DC-CHARGED-BACK`, computes `AD-AMOUNT` as `0 - DC-AMOUNT`, performs `WRITE-ADJUSTMENT`, and sets `DC-UPDATED` to `DE-DATE`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'N'` (not `HOLDING-NOTHING`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'OP'` (not `DE-OPENED`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'OP'` (not `DC-OPEN`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'CB'` (not `DE-CHARGEBACK`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`) and `DC-STATUS` is `'CB'` (`DC-CHARGED-BACK`) and `DE-EVENT` is `'AC'` (`DE-MERCHANT-ACCEPTS`), it sets `DC-STATUS` to `DC-WON` and sets `DC-UPDATED` to `DE-DATE`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'N'` (not `HOLDING-NOTHING`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'OP'` (not `DE-OPENED`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'OP'` (not `DC-OPEN`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'CB'` (not `DE-CHARGEBACK`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'AC'` (not `DE-MERCHANT-ACCEPTS`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`) and `DC-STATUS` is `'CB'` (`DC-CHARGED-BACK`) and `DE-EVENT` is `'RP'` (`DE-REPRESENTMENT`), it sets `DC-STATUS` to `DC-REPRESENTED`, sets `AD-AMOUNT` to `DC-AMOUNT`, performs `WRITE-ADJUSTMENT`, and sets `DC-UPDATED` to `DE-DATE`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'N'` (not `HOLDING-NOTHING`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'OP'` (not `DE-OPENED`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'OP'` (not `DC-OPEN`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'CB'` (not `DE-CHARGEBACK`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'AC'` (not `DE-MERCHANT-ACCEPTS`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'RP'` (not `DE-REPRESENTMENT`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`) and `DC-STATUS` is `'RP'` (`DC-REPRESENTED`) and `DE-EVENT` is `'DR'` (`DE-ISSUER-DROPS`), it sets `DC-STATUS` to `DC-LOST` and sets `DC-UPDATED` to `DE-DATE`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'N'` (not `HOLDING-NOTHING`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'OP'` (not `DE-OPENED`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'OP'` (not `DC-OPEN`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'CB'` (not `DE-CHARGEBACK`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'AC'` (not `DE-MERCHANT-ACCEPTS`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'RP'` (not `DE-REPRESENTMENT`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'RP'` (not `DC-REPRESENTED`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'DR'` (not `DE-ISSUER-DROPS`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`) and `DC-STATUS` is `'RP'` (`DC-REPRESENTED`) and `DE-EVENT` is `'PA'` (`DE-PRE-ARBITRATION`), it sets `DC-STATUS` to `DC-PRE-ARBITRATION` and sets `DC-UPDATED` to `DE-DATE`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'N'` (not `HOLDING-NOTHING`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'OP'` (not `DE-OPENED`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'OP'` (not `DC-OPEN`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'CB'` (not `DE-CHARGEBACK`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'AC'` (not `DE-MERCHANT-ACCEPTS`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'RP'` (not `DE-REPRESENTMENT`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'RP'` (not `DC-REPRESENTED`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'DR'` (not `DE-ISSUER-DROPS`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'RP'` (not `DC-REPRESENTED`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'PA'` (not `DE-PRE-ARBITRATION`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`) and `DC-STATUS` is `'PA'` (`DC-PRE-ARBITRATION`) and `DE-EVENT` is `'RI'` (`DE-RULED-FOR-ISSUER`), it sets `DC-STATUS` to `DC-WON`, computes `AD-AMOUNT` as `0 - DC-AMOUNT`, performs `WRITE-ADJUSTMENT`, and sets `DC-UPDATED` to `DE-DATE`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'N'` (not `HOLDING-NOTHING`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'OP'` (not `DE-OPENED`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'OP'` (not `DC-OPEN`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'CB'` (not `DE-CHARGEBACK`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'AC'` (not `DE-MERCHANT-ACCEPTS`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'RP'` (not `DE-REPRESENTMENT`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'RP'` (not `DC-REPRESENTED`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'DR'` (not `DE-ISSUER-DROPS`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'RP'` (not `DC-REPRESENTED`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'PA'` (not `DE-PRE-ARBITRATION`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'PA'` (not `DC-PRE-ARBITRATION`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'RI'` (not `DE-RULED-FOR-ISSUER`); and `WS-HOLDING` is `'Y'` (`HOLDING-CASE`) and `DC-STATUS` is `'PA'` (`DC-PRE-ARBITRATION`) and `DE-EVENT` is `'RM'` (`DE-RULED-FOR-MERCHANT`), it sets `DC-STATUS` to `DC-LOST` and sets `DC-UPDATED` to `DE-DATE`.

When `WS-HOLDING` is not `'N'` (not `HOLDING-NOTHING`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'OP'` (not `DE-OPENED`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'OP'` (not `DC-OPEN`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'CB'` (not `DE-CHARGEBACK`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'AC'` (not `DE-MERCHANT-ACCEPTS`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'CB'` (not `DC-CHARGED-BACK`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'RP'` (not `DE-REPRESENTMENT`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'RP'` (not `DC-REPRESENTED`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'DR'` (not `DE-ISSUER-DROPS`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'RP'` (not `DC-REPRESENTED`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'PA'` (not `DE-PRE-ARBITRATION`); `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'PA'` (not `DC-PRE-ARBITRATION`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'RI'` (not `DE-RULED-FOR-ISSUER`); and `WS-HOLDING` is not `'Y'` (not `HOLDING-CASE`) or `DC-STATUS` is not `'PA'` (not `DC-PRE-ARBITRATION`) or `DE-EVENT` is not `'RM'` (not `DE-RULED-FOR-MERCHANT`), it sets `REJECT-LINE` to spaces, sets `RJ-REASON` to `'STAT'`, sets `RJ-EVENT` to `DISPUTE-EVENT`, writes `REJECT-LINE`, sets `WS-RESULT` to 4, and leaves the section.
